tile_roads — DRIVE inf op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.tile_roads(i: 'int', j: 'int', tp: 'dict') -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import driveinf; driveinf.tile_roads(i: 'int', j: 'int', tp: 'dict') -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("tile_roads"))

Usage

Roads inside a tile: the crossing points (in-tile coordinates), the junction, and the segments from the junction to each point. Returns {"hub" (2,), "ends" [(side, (x, y))], "segments" (K, 2, 2)} (empty if there are no crossing points).
